text:
Alex: Heads-up — I found a handful of inconsistencies across the docs around product/parameter orthography. Not a huge blocker, but it's noisy for folks consuming SDK snippets. Example: some pages use `Redwood Dedicated`, others `Redwood-dedicated`, and a couple still say `dedicated capacity` (two words).
Priya: Ugh yeah. I hit that when updating the migration guide. Also saw `model_id`, `modelId`, and `model-id` used in different code examples. :grimacing:
Jordan: Can we agree on a small set of orthography rules? I'd propose: product names use Title Case (e.g., "Redwood Dedicated"), param names in SDKs use camelCase, route/cli flags use kebab-case, and JSON keys mirror the SDK shape (camelCase).
Sam: That sounds reasonable. Quick checklist?
Alex: Proposed checklist (one-liner each):
- Product names: Title Case, no hyphens (e.g., "Redwood Private").
- UI labels: Sentence case for UI copy.
- SDK params: camelCase (e.g., `modelId`, `maxTokens`).
- REST path/query: kebab-case for route segments, query params camelCase.
- JSON payloads: camelCase.
- Docs anchors/filenames: kebab-case (already most of our pages).
If we accept this, I'll codify in the style guide and run a quick grep-based sweep.
Priya: Can you add one more: "Avoid abbreviations in headers" — e.g., use "Model versioning" not "Model v." — translators hate abbreviations.
Jordan: Agree to abbreviations rule.
Sam: For migration guides specifically, can we add a short note to show both legacy and new param names side-by-side? Example snippet in the migration doc:```json
{
  "legacy": { "model_id": "rw-1" },
  "new": { "modelId": "rw-1" }
}
```
Alex: Good idea. I'll add that snippet to the migration guide PR.
docs-bot: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1287> opened by Alex — "style: orthography rules + migration snippet" :rocket:
Priya: I'll review the PR today. Also we should flag any SDK snippet tests — Jordan, can you run the snippet linter after the PR lands?
Jordan: Yep — I'll run snippet CI and do a pass for param names. If there are mismatches I can auto-apply fixes for code blocks using our script.
Sam: Two operational asks: 1) let's add a short note in the docs CONTRIBUTING.md about searching for `model_id` vs `modelId` before merging; 2) can we add a Danger check to warn when a commit touches more than 5 files with inconsistent casing? :pray:
Alex: Will add the CONTRIBUTING note and a tracking issue for Danger. If Danger is too noisy we'll throttle it after some runs.
Priya: One more: links — I spotted two internal links that point to old anchors after renaming. I'll paste them in the PR comments.
Alex: Thanks. Timeline: I want the orthography doc + migration snippet merged by Friday so we can run a global grep and open follow-up PRs for low-risk fixes next week. Everyone okay with that?
Sam: Fine by me. :+1:
Jordan: Fine.
Priya: Fine — I'll review ASAP.
Alex: Sweet. I'll push one follow-up commit to the PR to add the abbreviation rule and the migration example. Ping here when you've reviewed. :eyes:
docs-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1287 — "style: orthography rules + migration snippet" (merged by Alex) :tada:
